description: This file defines the AWS SyntheticsClient class which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the AWS Synthetics service API, including functionalities like creating, deleting, describing, and managing canaries and groups.

classes.name: SyntheticsClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with the AWS Synthetics service, providing methods like createCanary, deleteCanary, and others, extending the generic AwsClient.

methods.name: associateResource
methods.description: Associates a resource with the Synthetics service.

methods.name: getCanary
methods.description: Gets details about a specific canary.

methods.name: listGroups
methods.description: Lists groups associated with the canaries.
